bill.title: A resolution designating May 2026 as "ALS Awareness Month".
bill.latestActionText: Resolution agreed to in Senate without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S2518)

classification.plainSummary:
A resolution designating May 2026 as "ALS Awareness Month".

This is a commemorative or honorific measure ("designating May 2026 as "ALS Awareness Month"). It carries no sector tags and no donor overlap is computed for it, because attributing an economic interest to a commemorative or procedural measure would be misleading.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
